loveLetter.title: A Letter I Couldn't Say Out Loud
loveLetter.content:
Dear you,

I'm not great at saying this out loud, so I'm writing it down.

Thank you for the quiet days, the loud ones, and every ordinary moment you made feel like something worth keeping.

You make the small stuff feel like the whole point. Thank you for the patience, the bad jokes, and the way you show up without being asked. I'd choose you on every version of this day..

Yours, always.
